MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
Northstar Logistics Systems Ltd. and Meridian Facilities Group
Document type: Supplier master services agreement
Effective date: 2026-01-15
Annual platform fee: EUR 48,000
The provider shall maintain an operational service desk during business hours.

TERM, RENEWAL AND SECURITY
The agreement renews on 2027-01-15 unless either party gives 60 days written notice.
Northstar shall notify Meridian of a confirmed security incident within 24 hours.
Service owner: Mira Talen, vendor.operations@example.test.
No subcontractor may access production data without written approval.

# Incident report: routing delay

Incident date: 2026-04-12

Northstar's route optimisation feed was delayed for 18 minutes between 09:14 and 09:32 UTC.

The on-call coordinator recorded the incident as SEV-2.

## Follow-up

The incident report states that customer notification should occur within 48 hours. This report does not amend the supplier agreement.

Owner: Operations Reliability Team.

Risk: the 48-hour report target conflicts with the 24-hour contractual notification obligation.
